la Vila Olímpica del Poblenou — Barcelona, Spain

Relatively safer day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Daytime (beach/marina/promenade) has no particular documented concern. At night, the Port Olímpic nightlife strip has a recurring pattern of violent incidents in press coverage: a man was stabbed there around 21:30 on 8 May 2026 during a confrontation between two groups, echoing an earlier fatal stabbing case at Port Olímpic. Separately, the adjacent Carles I park was gated and closed at night in 2019 after police records showed recurring fights, drug consumption, robberies and other criminal offenses. Sources checked: Metrópoli Abierta, 9 May 2026 / 4 Aug 2019; Telecinco/Republica.com.
